title: Olive Young to open five more US stores in significant K-beauty expansion
summary: K-Beauty retailer Olive Young’s new US stores will be located across Greater Los Angeles and San Diego, with plans to complete construction on all five sites in the first half of 2027

extraction.key_fact: 올리브영이 미국 캘리포니아에 매장을 추가로 열어 K뷰티 유통을 넓힌다.
